title: stt.audioInput node config (mandatory)
description: Declares how audio reaches this pipeline. `mode: 'realtime'` carries no further config — a realtime session supplies audio at session-open time via the existing WS gateway (stt-ws.gateway.ts), never through this node's config. `mode: 'batch'` carries a `mediaId`/`audioUri` reference mirroring apps/stt's transcribe_file worker params. `if`/`then`/`else` is excluded from the authorable subset (packages/json-schema-subset), so mode-conditional field requirements (e.g. 'batch requires mediaId or audioUri') are enforced by the impure, repository-backed validator layer, not by this schema.
